[COURSEWORK / PROJECT SUMMARY]{.eyebrow}

## The question

How can cloud-query work be organized so another reader can follow it?

## Approach

BigQuery coursework extends SQL learning into a cloud analytics environment. Quarto reporting provides a place to explain the question, query approach, and interpretation.

## What this work demonstrates

A query result needs context: what was counted, which data were selected, and what the result can support. These are learning notes, not a claim of client performance or production engineering.
